name: reacut
description: Local video editing inside the Codex side panel. Requires ReaCut 0.5.0+.

interface.shortDescription: Edit local videos in the Codex side panel
interface.longDescription: Open the ReaCut editor in the Codex side panel to edit timelines, text, effects, transitions and local exports. Codex can read project state and propose reversible batch edits. Requires an installed ReaCut app; ordinary editing does not require a cloud account or API key. Windows side-panel hosting is experimental.
defaultPrompt: Open ReaCut in the side panel.
Edit my selected local media in ReaCut and keep an editable project.
